{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: converted, non-refunded, non-QA orders
filtered_data = data[
    (data['converted'] == 1) &
    (data['status'] != 'refunded') &
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute number of refunded orders
num_refunded = len(data[data['status'] == 'refunded'])
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}')

# Compute number of converted orders
num_converted = len(data[data['converted'] == 1])
print(f'Number of converted orders: {num_converted}')

# Compute number of QA orders
num_qa = len(data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99])
print(f'Number of QA orders: {num_qa}')

# Compute final number of valid orders
num_valid = len(filtered_data)
print(f'Number of valid (converted, non-refunded, non-QA) orders: {num_valid}')

# Compute raw average revenue by channel
raw_avg_revenue_by_channel = filtered_data.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'Raw average revenue by channel (unadjusted):\n{raw_avg_revenue_by_channel}')

# Compute stratified average revenue by channel
stratified_means = filtered_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
channel_totals = filtered_data.groupby('channel').size()
segment_counts = filtered_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
segment_weights = segment_counts.div(segment_counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0)
weighted_avg_revenue = (stratified_means * segment_weights).sum(axis=1)
print(f'Stratified mean revenue by channel (weighted by segment size):\n{weighted_avg_revenue}')

# Compute difference
avg_revenue_email = weighted_avg_revenue['email']
avg_revenue_paid_search = weighted_avg_revenue['paid_search']
difference = avg_revenue_email - avg_revenue_paid_search
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.2f} USD')"}
